frequency_question: What proportion of threatened industry-wide strikes by major labor coalitions result in actual initiation rather than deferral or cancellation due to institutional friction (e.g., conciliation boards, statutory cooling-off periods, compulsory arbitration, or court injunctions)?
membership_rule: Includes all formal strike notices issued by multi-union national confederations in federally or nationally regulated industries where statutory conciliation or institutional intervention mechanisms apply. Excludes wildcat strikes, single-employer strikes, and strikes without formal conciliation mandates.

coverage_note: 12 named reference cases representing major national statutory/federated labor dispute processes; captures the friction success rate where institutional intervention prevents initiation.
known_gaps: Does not exhaustively list every minor regional bank branch union notice globally, but heavily samples national-level multi-union federation notices.
validity_reason: Labor laws and statutory conciliation frameworks governing major national unions change slowly over multi-year legislative cycles.
